title: The route to the exemption: transfer to a provident fund for annuity from age 60

source.title: Retirement Age Law, s.5: "גיל 60 לגבר ולאישה"

early_retirement_age.notes: From the early retirement age the balance may be moved to a provident fund for annuity, into an annuitants' track, for an annuity only (transfer regulations reg. 2(א)(7), 2(ב)(2)).
